mostWorthwhile.text: Building the weighted sensors was worthwhile because comparing them with the turning sensors clarified how they respond to different movements.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two sensor types mainly placed them together; it was useful for locating them but less revealing than building them.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the weighted sensors respond to changes in straight-line movement as well as tilt.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though joining the two sensor types felt more like assembly than explaining a new connection.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: connecting the sensors to familiar eye and posture movements made me curious about other body systems.
